mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BATGERS_MATCH_PUBG_DETAIL ( matchNo, matchId, playerNo, playerNm, playerId, mmr, mmrDelta, loserFlag, winPlace, damageDealt, damagePenalty, kills, dbnos, assists, revives, teamKills, timeSurvived, startDate ) VALUES ( #{matchNo}, #{matchId}, #{playerNo}, #{playerNm}, #{playerId}, #{mmr}, #{mmrDelta}, #{loserFlag}, #{winPlace}, ROUND(#{damageDealt}, 4), #{damagePenalty}, #{kills}, #{dbnos}, #{assists}, #{revives}, #{teamKills}, #{timeSurvived}, CONVERT_TZ(#{startDate}, '+00:00', '+09:00') )
mapper.update: UPDATE BATGERS_MATCH_PUBG_DETAIL SET matchId = #{matchId}, loserFlag = #{loserFlag}, damageDealt = ROUND(#{damageDealt}, 4), damagePenalty = #{damagePenalty}, kills = #{kills}, dbnos = #{dbnos}, assists = #{assists}, revives = #{revives}, teamKills = #{teamKills}, timeSurvived = #{timeSurvived}, startDate = CONVERT_TZ(#{startDate}, '+00:00', '+09:00') WHERE idx = #{idx}
mapper.select: SELECT a.matchNo, DATE_FORMAT(a.regDate, '%Y-%m-%d %T') AS regDate, b.playerIdPUBG FROM BATGERS_MATCH_CHILD AS a INNER JOIN BATGERS_PLAYER_LIST AS b ON a.loser = b.playerNo WHERE a.gameCd = 1 AND a.parentCd = #{parentCd} AND a.matchIdPUBG IS NULL
